name: corallineage
description: Root-level dev launcher for corallineage-backend, corallineage-frontend, corallineage-ml-service, and docker-compose infra

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "infra,backend,frontend,ml" --prefix-colors "yellow,blue,green,magenta" "docker-compose up" "cd corallineage-backend && mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run" "cd corallineage-frontend && npm run dev" "corallineage-ml-service\\venv\\Scripts\\python.exe corallineage-ml-service\\app.py"
